description: This file defines classes and functions for audit trail logging in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including rules, logs, log lines, and a proxy for object method call interception.

classes.name: audittrail_rule
classes.description: Defines audit rules for models, including subscribing and unsubscribing to log changes.

classes.name: audittrail_log
classes.description: Represents audit log entries, including timestamp, user, object, and method.

classes.name: audittrail_log_line
classes.description: Represents individual log lines detailing field changes.

classes.name: audittrail_objects_proxy
classes.description: Proxy class that intercepts object method calls to log create, write, read, and delete operations based on rules.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a view log action and updates rule state to subscribed.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes view log actions and resets rule state to draft.

methods.name: log_fct
methods.description: Logs create, write, read, and unlink method calls with detailed field change information.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Intercepts method calls on models to apply audit rules and trigger logging.

methods.name: get_value_text
methods.description: Retrieves human-readable text for field values, handling relational fields.

methods.name: create_log_line
methods.description: Creates log line entries for field changes.
